_description: Baseline comparison for gold standard 31 cases — literature-validated binary sensitivity/resistance labels

t4_ctrp_lookup_only.description: T4 (pharmacology agent) alone — near-direct CTRPv2 database lookup
t4_ctrp_lookup_only.note: Highest AUROC but CTRPv2 measures same biological signal as literature labels for well-studied cases. Does not generalise to novel drugs.

t1_civic_oncokb_only.description: T1 (genomics agent) alone — CIViC + OncoKB knowledge base rules

no_debate_majority_vote.description: All 4 agents, majority-vote aggregation, no debate rounds

monolithic_llm.description: Single LLM with all omics data — no specialised agents, no debate

rf_on_ctrp_omics_features.features: target gene mutation, target expression z-score, driver mutation flags (21 cancer genes)
rf_on_ctrp_omics_features.interpretation: Traditional ML trained on 108K pharmacogenomic pairs is worse than random on mechanistically complex gold-standard cases. Learns population-level rules (EGFR_mutated->SENSITIVE) but cannot distinguish resistance-conferring variants (T790M) from sensitising ones (L858R). Validates the need for variant-level mechanistic reasoning.

DRN_CDR.citation: Saranya KR, Vimina ER. DRN-CDR: A cancer drug response prediction model using multi-omics and drug features. Comput Biol Chem. 2024;112:108175. PMID:39191166
DRN_CDR.reason_not_run: Requires DNA methylation data (CCLE) not in our pipeline; predicts continuous IC50 not binary classification; training set includes our 22 cell lines (overlap).
DRN_CDR.comparison_note: Strong at IC50 interpolation within GDSC distribution. RF proxy result (AUROC 0.475) suggests ResNet-level models similarly fail on mechanistically complex cases requiring variant-level reasoning, not captured by gene-level binary mutation flags.

EvoMDT.citation: Liu Q, Hu Z, Huang T et al. EvoMDT: a self-evolving multi-agent system for structured clinical decision-making in multi-cancer. npj Digit Med. 2026;9:124. doi:10.1038/s41746-025-02304-8
EvoMDT.task: Oncology QA and clinical treatment recommendation (NOT cell-line drug response prediction)
EvoMDT.reason_not_run: Different task: clinical treatment recommendation, not mechanistic drug-response prediction for cancer cell lines.

architectural_comparison.shared: Multi-agent specialised roles, evidence-grounded reasoning, conflict resolution protocol, traceable provenance
architectural_comparison.EvoMDT_unique: Self-evolving prompt/weight update loop, safety-first consensus, pan-cancer clinical knowledge base, physician-in-the-loop evaluation
architectural_comparison.our_system_unique: Modality-specific axiom hierarchy (T1>T2>T3>T4), unanimity consensus with AxiomChallenge, GCS scoring formula, FastMCP evidence retrieval gates, formal T3 quality constraints
architectural_comparison.note: EvoMDT validates multi-agent reasoning for cancer AI at the clinical level. Our system applies the same paradigm to the complementary problem of pre-clinical mechanistic drug response prediction.

summary_table.note: 108K training pairs, fails on complex cases
